biotools.summary: This tool performs k-mer genome-wide association studies (GWAS) to identify markers associated with anthracnose and bean common mosaic virus (BCMV) resistance in the Andean Diversity Panel of common beans. The analysis uses historical data and incorporates insights from genome sequencing and structural variation.
